notes: DHIS2 v2.40+ exposes an Event Hooks API (`/api/eventHooks`) for metadata and scheduler events; this needs `event_hooks.enabled = on` in `dhis.conf`. Event Hooks support webhook, Apache Artemis JMS and Kafka targets. Tracker and aggregate data changes are NOT covered by event hooks — use cursor polling with `updatedAfter` / `lastUpdated` filters. Program Notifications can target external URLs but their reliability as production webhooks is unclear.

triggers.name: Metadata Changed
triggers.description: Fires when any metadata object (data element, org unit, indicator, program, etc.) is created, updated or deleted. Subscribe via the Event Hooks API with source path `metadata`. Supports field selection on the source (e.g. `fields=id,code,name`).

output.summary: Event Hook payload wrapping the changed metadata object

triggers.name: Data Element Updated
triggers.description: Fires when a data element definition is created, updated or deleted. Event Hooks API with source path `metadata.dataElement`. Useful for keeping downstream data dictionaries in sync.

triggers.name: Organisation Unit Updated
triggers.description: Fires when an organisation unit is created, modified or deleted. Event Hooks API with source path `metadata.organisationUnit`. Use this to mirror DHIS2's facility hierarchy to other systems.

triggers.name: Scheduler Job Completed
triggers.description: Fires when a scheduled job (analytics, resource tables, predictors, data integrity, etc.) completes. Event Hooks API with source path `scheduler.{JobType}`. Use to chain workflows off DHIS2's internal scheduler.

triggers.name: Analytics Table Generated
triggers.description: Fires when the analytics tables are regenerated. Event Hooks API with source path `scheduler.ANALYTICS_TABLE`. A useful trigger for refreshing dashboards or downstream warehouses.

triggers.name: New Tracker Event
triggers.description: Fires when a new tracker event is created or updated. Poll `/api/tracker/events?updatedAfter={cursor}` on a schedule, advancing the cursor on success. Supports pagination.

triggers.name: New Enrollment
triggers.description: Fires when a new enrollment is created in a tracker program. Poll `/api/tracker/enrollments?updatedAfter={cursor}` on a schedule.

triggers.name: New Tracked Entity
triggers.description: Fires when a new tracked entity instance is registered. Poll `/api/tracker/trackedEntities?updatedAfter={cursor}` on a schedule.

triggers.name: New Data Value Set
triggers.description: Fires when new aggregate data values are submitted. Poll `/api/dataValueSets` with a `lastUpdated` filter on a schedule.

triggers.name: Data Set Completed
triggers.description: Fires when an aggregate data set registration is marked complete for a given period and org unit. Poll `/api/completeDataSetRegistrations` on a schedule.

triggers.name: Program Notification Fired
triggers.description: Fires when a DHIS2 program notification rule fires (e.g. on enrollment / event completion). Program notifications can target external URLs but delivery semantics are not well documented. Fallback: poll tracker events directly.

triggers.name: New Message
triggers.description: Fires when a new message conversation arrives. DHIS2 has a messaging system but no documented cursor-based polling endpoint. Fallback: poll `/api/messageConversations` if available on the target version.
